instruction: Please configure VS Code to open both workspace1.code-workspace and workspace2.code-workspace in a split workspace view within the same window.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not support split workspace views. While VS Code can split editor panes to show different files, it cannot split the workspace context itself to have two different workspaces active simultaneously in the same window. A window can only have one workspace context at a time.
metadata.infeasibility_reason: VS Code does not support split workspace views or multiple workspace contexts per window
